			<category name="Fast Travel - Bank - Stash - Quick Change From Anywhere - Version 2.5 (imported from travel.txt)">
				<comment>Mod written by GitHub: Our Lord And Savior Gabe Newell / Nexus Mods: OB4MA</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>Not compatible with Loot Midget World or any other map merging mod since the most recent game update.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>This mod allows you to open up Fast Travel, Bank, Claptrap Stash and Quick Change UI from anywhere within a map with the touch of a button as long as you are not in the air.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>Quick Change Stations can be brought up anywhere by pressing the "#9" key.</comment>
				<comment>Banks can be brought up anywhere by pressing the "#7" key.</comment>
				<comment>Claptrap Stashes can be brought up anywhere by pressing the "#8" key.</comment>
				<comment>Fast Travel Stations can be brought up anywhere by pressing the "#0" key.</comment>
				<comment>These binds can be changed by pressing Escape > Options > Keyboard / Mouse > Key Bindings and scrolling down to the very bottom of the list.</comment>
				<comment>If you forget to execute this mod, do not fret, your new bindings for these will be saved by the game to allow seamless use of it.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>This mod makes the default sorting in the Fast Travel UI be in Alphabetical order (with DLC groupings).</comment>
				<comment>Has a customizable folder for new Fast Travel locations.</comment>
				<comment>Additionally this mod allows you to change the time it takes to travel.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>I did an overhaul for a lot of UIs for this mod, this includes Quick Change Stations (now needs arrows keys to scroll due to how crappy their UI was done), the player Bank, Claptrap's Secret Stash and Vehicle Stations.</comment>
				<comment>Additionally, I uncapped useful in-game settings, so have fun customizing settings much more to your liking!</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>Number Seven [7] is the Bank UI.             Can be rebound via Escape > Options > Keyboard / Mouse > Key Bindings > Open Bank.</comment>
				<comment>Number Eight [8] is the Claptrap Stash UI.   Can be rebound via Escape > Options > Keyboard / Mouse > Key Bindings > Open Claptrap Stash.</comment>
				<comment>Number Nine  [9] is the Quick Change UI.     Can be rebound via Escape > Options > Keyboard / Mouse > Key Bindings > Open Quick Change.</comment>
				<comment>Number Zero  [0] is the Fast Travel UI.      Can be rebound via Escape > Options > Keyboard / Mouse > Key Bindings > Open Fast Travel.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>Whenever you press 7, 8, 9, 0 or whatever you rebound them to, you enable additional binds to be used.  I tried to make some others binds that I thought would be useful, but they did not work as binds.</comment>
				<comment>[CTRL + NumPad 0] disables travelling.</comment>
				<comment>[ALT  + NumPad 0] enables travelling.</comment>
				<comment>[CTRL + NumPad 9] disables Quick Change fake lighting.</comment>
				<comment>[ALT  + NumPad 9] turns Quick Change fake lighting back on.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>If you forget these binds, the pause menu will display information about them in a cycle of 7 seconds per information post.</comment>
				<category name="Necessary Code">

				<comment>By Koby</comment>
				<comment>Image Album: https://imgur.com/a/AEZNy</comment>
				<comment>Changes the rarity color of unique aftermarket items to a dark teal to be more distinguishable from other items.</comment>
				<comment>Changes the color of Moxxi weapons to a blood red.</comment>
				<comment>Supports Gemstone weapons from the Unofficial Community Patch.</comment>
				<comment>Changes the order of items in the inventory: Pearl -> Seraph -> (Unique Legendaries if enabled) -> Legendary -> Moxxi -> Unique -> Gemstone -> E-Tech -> Very Rare...</comment>
				<comment>Has an optional module to turn all Heads and Skins to a grey-ish color.</comment>
				<comment>Has an optional module to turn all Legendary items which don't world drop into Dark Orange items (Unique Uniques).</comment>
				<comment>Has 2 money color options: Mint green money (default) and normal yellow.</comment>
				<comment>Also has a colorblind option for green rarity (not guaranteed to apply to your colorblindness!)</comment>

				<comment>Also thanks to FromDarkHell for writing me a script for the Heads and Skins.</comment>

				<comment># the frequencies the same.</comment>

				<category name="Description">
					<comment>Changes the 'Slag Damage' attribute to multiplicative Non-Elemental Damage.</comment>
					<comment>In vanilla, this means all 'slag damage' elemental relics will now have Non-Elemental Damage instead.</comment>
					<comment>If you have a mod that enables Slag Bone of the Ancients, your Slag Bone of the Ancients will now become Non-ELemental Bone of the Ancients.</comment>
					<comment>If you have any skill or item that boosts Slag Damage, they will boost Non-Elemental Damage instead.</comment>
					<comment></comment>
					<comment>Probably not compatible with Cryo mods(or any element mod that replaces Slag)</comment>
					<comment>Also does not affect the UVHM Slag Bonus Damage boost, so you dont have to worry about Slag getting weaker.</comment>
				</category>

			<category name="Player HUD Element Remover - Version 1.1 (imported from PlayerHUDElementRemover.blcm)">
				<comment>Mod written by GitHub: Our Lord And Savior Gabe Newell / Nexus Mods: OB4MA</comment>
				<comment>This mod simply allows you to toggle off various parts of your HUD and now crosshairs.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>Customize portions of your HUD that you would like to disable outright.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>Tired of reload messages or fight for your life health bars?</comment>
				<comment>Don't want to see your level and class mod name either?</comment>
				<comment>If you are level 72 and don't care to see your XP Bar, no problem.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
				<comment>This really can disable just about everything on your HUD without screwing functionality of anything like ToggleHUD does.</comment>
				<comment></comment>
